Metadata.title: Earth Leveling
Metadata.description: Earth Leveling — The Ultimate Semi-RP Earth Simulation
Metadata.worldDescription: Explore the interactive world of Earth Leveling. Visualize territories, nations, and conflict zones on the 3D globe.

News.title: News
News.article1Title: Earth Leveling — A New Era of Semi-RP Simulation Begins
News.article2Title: The First Gates Have Been Detected — Hunters, Prepare Yourselves
News.article3Title: Nations Rise: How Guilds Will Shape the World's Political Landscape

Characters.desc1: Earth Leveling is a unique world, shared by all players, inspired by Solo Leveling.
Characters.desc2: Nations rise, guilds dominate, and players shape history through wars, alliances, and conquest.
Characters.desc3: Explore a Earth transformed by portals, where power is earned through effort, strategy, and influence, in a persistent experience blending action, progression, and political stakes.

Features.title: A living World to Conquer
Features.feature1Desc: Every action matters. Player decisions, wars, alliances, and discoveries permanently shape the world and its history.
Features.feature2Desc: Join or build powerful guilds, serve your nation, conquer territories, and influence global balance through diplomacy or conflict.
Features.feature3Desc: Become a Hunter, a Nation Leader, a Scientist, or a strategist in the shadows. Each role offers unique gameplay and impact.
Features.feature4Desc: Train like a Hunter. Earth Leveling features its own Solo Leveling–inspired training app to track progression, challenges, and personal growth beyond the game.
Features.feature5Desc: Hidden systems, world events, secrets, and evolving mechanics await those who push beyond the limits.

Majors.title: The Majors
Majors.subtitle: THE FIRST THREE MAJOR UPDATES OF A LONG SERIES TO COME, PLANNED FOR 2027–2028
Majors.card1Desc1: The first Raids S-Rank Class Dungeons emerge.
Majors.card1Desc2: Death is no longer temporary. Some losses scar forever, others erase everything.
Majors.card2Desc2: Nations that master clean energy gain long-term advantages in production, defense, and sustainability.

WorldEvolution.title: Earth Leveling
WorldEvolution.feature1Desc: Every action matters. The world evolves through player decisions, wars, alliances, and long-term consequences.
WorldEvolution.feature2Desc: Choose your role. Hunter, Nation Leader, Scientist, Strategist, .... Each path offers unique mechanics, responsibilities, and impact.
WorldEvolution.feature3Desc: Form guilds, build nations, control territories, and shape geopolitics. Diplomacy can be as powerful as force.
WorldEvolution.feature4Desc: From early Gates to S-Rank Class Raids, danger scales with ambition. Failure has consequences — sometimes permanent.
WorldEvolution.feature5Desc: Major updates, global events, and hidden systems continuously reshape the world. Nothing stays static. Adapt or fall behind.

OpenWorld.title: The Largest Semi-RP UGC Open World
OpenWorld.subtitle: YES, YES! THE BIGGEST ONE
OpenWorld.card1Desc: Your actions, training, and choices shape your progression. There are no fixed paths — power is earned, not given.
OpenWorld.card2Desc: Alliances, betrayals, wars, and sacrifices permanently affect your character and the world around you.
OpenWorld.card3Desc: Power comes from experience, discovery, and risk. The more you dare, the further you evolve.
OpenWorld.card4Title: Shape Your Role in the World
OpenWorld.card4Desc: Hunter, Leader, Scientist and much more. Your progression continues beyond the game through the Earth Leveling mobile app.
OpenWorld.card5Desc: Local proximity chat is automatically translated in real time, allowing players from all nations to interact naturally. English remains the shared international language for voice communication between different parties.

Paths.title: Multiple paths. One destiny
Paths.subtitle: WHAT WILL YOURS BE
Paths.note: A second specialization is possible, but progression will be slower.
Paths.hunterDesc1: Hunters stand on the front line against Gates, dungeons, and world-level threats. They grow through real combat, high-risk Raids, and constant confrontation with death.
Paths.hunterDesc2: The greater the danger, the faster the ascent, but failure may carry permanent consequences.
Paths.scientistDesc1: Scientists study Gates, anomalies, energy systems, and forbidden technologies. Their discoveries unlock new infrastructures, advanced systems, and world-changing innovations.
Paths.scientistDesc2: Progress comes with responsibility, and sometimes, irreversible consequences.
Paths.engineerDesc1: Engineers turn ideas into reality. They design and maintain infrastructures, energy networks, defenses, and industrial systems. They are also responsible for developing weapons, equipment, and advanced gear used by Hunters on the battlefield.
Paths.engineerDesc2: Without Engineers, progress stops and wars are lost before they begin.
Paths.leaderDesc1: Nation Leaders govern territories, populations, and institutions. They define laws, manage diplomacy, declare wars, and shape national identity.
Paths.leaderDesc2: Every decision leaves a mark. Prosperity, rebellion, or collapse.
Paths.strategistDesc1: Economic Strategists are masters of long-term dominance. They create and manage companies, control resource flows, shape markets, and influence global development. Through economic planning, corporate power, and discreet espionage, they weaken rivals long before conflict begins.
Paths.strategistDesc2: Their battlefield is invisible, but decisive.
Paths.mysteryDesc: New specializations, hidden roles, and classified systems will emerge as the world evolves.

Footer.triggersDesc: Triggers Studio is an independent game development studio crafting immersive, player-driven worlds. Our mission is to push the boundaries of simulation and community-driven experiences.
